questions.q: Who sends blessings upon the Prophet SAW according to this lecture?
options: Allah and the angels, and we are commanded to do so
questions.explain: Salawat is a special act of worship because Allah and the angels send blessings upon him.

questions.q: Why should we be grateful for the health blessings of today?
options: Because in the past childbirth and raising children risked life, and medicine now saves many
Because there are no diseases any more
questions.explain: Be thankful for the health blessings of this age.

questions.q: What did Halimah's husband say when she hesitated to take the orphan baby?
options: Allah may give provision through another way

questions.q: What did Halimah's husband show in calming his wife?
questions.explain: Halimah's husband showed empathy, and Halimah's hilm made the home calm.

questions.q: What is shaped when a child plays with nature, clouds, mountains and rivers?
options: Character and refinement of the soul
questions.explain: Nature shapes a child's soul and character.

questions.q: What are children according to this lecture?
options: A trust that will be questioned
questions.explain: Parents must find ways to give children a better life.

questions.q: When should technology be given to children?
options: When the child is ready, not forced on them from early on
questions.explain: Technology has benefits but has its time and stage.

questions.q: One or two bad incidents justify generalising and keeping children locked at home.
questions.explain: False. Do not fear so much that children are stopped from exploring.

questions.q: The first three years of a child's life are very decisive.
questions.explain: True. Early neglect will need repair later.

questions.q: Who has a role in ensuring children grow up well?
questions.explain: Protecting childhood is a shared responsibility.

questions.q: The realities of the sirah can be viewed purely through today's lens.
questions.explain: False. Understand the sirah in the context of its time.
